dedupe_keys.name: os open roads connected road network of great britain ordnance survey

description: OS Open Roads is a high-level, connected link-and-node representation of the road network of Great Britain. It contains the central alignment of all classified roads (motorways, A and B roads) and officially named unclassified roads, from motorways to country lanes, with generalised geometry, network connectivity and road classes, and motorway junctions. It is produced by Ordnance Survey as part of its OS OpenData products and is updated every six months. Coverage is national (Great Britain). It is free for everyone under the Open Government Licence and can be downloaded from Ordnance Survey as shapefile, GeoPackage, GML or vector tiles; Esri UK and other Living Atlas items also serve it as feature services. Caveats: the geometry is generalised for a high-level view, some Living Atlas copies were last refreshed in 2021, and Northern Ireland is not covered. It supports national road network models, accessibility and routing analysis, and exposure of roads to flooding and other hazards. It complements the more detailed OS MasterMap Highways Network and the National Highways network model catalogued here.
